verdict.rationale: Zep exposes the core memory operations as callable APIs. Messages and data are added and ingested into the Context Graph via `thread.add_messages`, which can also return context mid-turn. Hybrid semantic plus BM25 graph search is available, and edges and nodes can be deleted via `client.graph.edge.delete`. Agents reach these through framework integrations that support Context Graph search and through the Memory MCP Server, which connects MCP clients to their memory. Missing for 10: an explicit agent-invoked update/edit operation (fact changes appear to be handled automatically via temporal invalidation), documentation of which tools the MCP server exposes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
